Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst manifest Thy Beauty unto the people of Thy kingdom and didst send upon all created things the breezes of the grace of Thy mercy, to forgive this servant who hath clung to the cord of Thy loving care and held fast to the hem of Thy bounty. Then grant him, O my God, that which will detach him from all else but Thee and enable him to attain unto the shore of Thy nearness, for in Thy hands is the dominion of all things and Thou art, verily, powerful over all things.

## BH10847: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Do Thou aid… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty

Glorified art Thou, O my God! Do Thou aid those who have sought no help except through the wondrous aids of Thy triumph and victory, and who have turned to none save Thy gracious countenance, and who have faced none but Thy resplendent beauty. Therefore, O my Beloved, have mercy upon them through the sovereignty of Thy mercy, and deprive them not of Thy grace and bounties, nor of attaining Thy presence and Thy gifts. Verily, Thou art powerful over all things.

## BH10848: We have been afflicted with a most grievous calamity… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted is He!

We have been afflicted with a most grievous calamity, and trial and hardship, and darkness of tribulation. Yet through God's grace the Sun has risen from the supreme horizon. Behold, it moves before Us at Our behest. Soon will it transform the darkness of night into the light of day through its effulgence and radiance, and its signs will appear throughout all regions. Blessed is he who remains firm upon the throne of steadfastness and power in the Cause of his Lord, the Mighty, the Chosen One.

## BH10889: Although this evil state in which I am, O… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Forgiver!

Although this evil state in which I am, O my God, maketh me deserving of Thy wrath and punishment, Thy good pleasure and Thy bounties demand Thy forgiveness to encompass Thy servants and Thy good favour to reach them. I ask Thee by Thy Name which Thou hast made the King of all names to protect me by Thy power and Thine omnipotence from all calamity and all that is repugnant to Thee and all that is contrary to Thy Will. Thou art Supreme over all things.

## BH10973: O Thou Whose face is the object of my… {.unnumbered}

O Thou Whose face is the object of my adoration, Whose beauty is my sanctuary, Whose habitation is my goal, Whose praise is my hope, Whose providence is my companion, Whose love is the cause of my being, Whose mention is my solace, Whose nearness is my desire, Whose presence is my dearest wish and highest aspiration, I entreat Thee not to withhold from me the things Thou didst ordain for the chosen ones among Thy servants. Supply me, then, with the good of this world and of the next.

Thou, truly, art the King of all men. There is no God but Thee, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Generous.

## BH11013: O leaf! The odor of misbelief hath wafted… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Holy, the Most Glorious.

O leaf! The odor of misbelief hath wafted from the heart of every base misbeliever. Hold fast to this Tree lest thou fall upon the face of the earth. Thus doth command thee the Pen of sublime justice. Hold fast to the Tree, then taste of the fruits of the Lote-Tree of Paradise and be steadfast in the love of God.

## BH11011: O Guest! Bear witness within thyself that He… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty

O Guest! Bear witness within thyself that He is God, alone with no partner. His is the glory and the eternity, His the grandeur and the splendor, His the sovereignty and the cloud of divinity. He doeth whatsoever He willeth through His power, and He, verily, is the Sovereign, the All-Knowing, the Ruler, the Self-Subsisting. Then make mention of Majid and Baqir and Muhsin.

## BH11025: O Dhabih! The heart hath been created… {.unnumbered}

O Dhabih! The heart hath been created for the recognition of the Lord of Lords. Defile it not with the love of any other, and at all times strive with utmost effort to preserve this exalted and sublime essence, lest it be veiled by veils or barred by glory from the Lord of Attributes....

## BH11176: O Greatest Branch! By the life of God, thy… {.unnumbered}

He is the Healer, the Mighty, the All-Wise!

O Greatest Branch! By the life of God, thy afflictions have grieved Me, but God will heal thee and protect thee, for He is the Best, the Gracious, and the Most Excellent Helper. The glory rest upon thee and upon those who serve thee and circle round thee. Woe and torment be upon those who oppose thee and harm thee. Blessed is he who befriendeth thee, and hell-fire be upon him who is thine enemy.

## BH11012: O Hadi! Be patient in what hath befallen thee… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty!

O Hadi! Be patient in what hath befallen thee and what hath befallen Us from the irrevocable and manifest decree. Put thy trust in God, for in Him do the sincere ones place their trust. Fear thou no one, then stand firm in love and be of the patient ones. Then remind from Our presence thy son that he may be of the content ones.

## BH11007: O Jamshid! Be thou patient in separation and be… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty

O Jamshid! Be thou patient in separation and be not distressed within thyself, and be of them that are patient. Then beseech God that He may bring about a reunion between us and you, for verily He hath power over all things. And the Spirit be upon thee and upon the patient servants of God.

## BH11005: O My handmaiden! By God, at all times doth… {.unnumbered}

He is the Sorrowful

O My handmaiden! By God, at all times doth the Tongue of God give utterance to verses of grief, whereas the oceans of life should be flowing in recognition of My All-Merciful Self. Therefore, the curse of God be upon those who have wronged Me without clear proof or an illuminating Book. And thou, remember thy Lord, then be devoutly obedient, that thou mayest be accounted among those who remember, recorded by the Pen of God.

## BH11046: since the eternal Sovereign is unlimited and unknowable, whatsoever… {.unnumbered}

...since the eternal Sovereign is unlimited and unknowable, whatsoever proceedeth from the Source of His sanctified glory hath not been and will never be confined to any single soul, but descendeth without limitation. Therefore, any handmaid of God who remaineth steadfast in the path of God and detached from all else besides Him—she is the true handmaid of God.

## BH11022: O friends! Come forth from the garden of self… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting

O friends! Come forth from the garden of self and passion, and enter gracefully into the paradise of the love of Baha. Step out of the realm of fancy into the arena of certitude. Though ere long all shall be deprived of this spiritual revelation and this mighty sovereign dawning, save whom thy Lord willeth, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

## BH11049: Praise be to God Who hath wafted the holy… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty

Praise be to God Who hath wafted the holy breezes from the divine paradise of meaning upon all created things, that all might behold with both outward and inward vision the lights of the Divine Beauty, and that none upon earth might be prevented or held back from the remembrance of the True Object of Worship. Thus hath it been sent down in truth, if ye would but know.

## BH11068: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Praise be unto… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Most Great, the Most Glorious!

Glorified art Thou, O my God! Praise be unto Thee for having made me the lamp of the worlds and the light of those who know Thee. Thou knowest, O my God, that mine eyes are turned toward Thy servants. Deliver them, O my God, from self and passion, and draw them nigh unto the Most Glorious Horizon in Thy days. Verily, Thou art the Generous. There is no God but Thee, the Great.

## BH11069: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Praise be unto… {.unnumbered}

In the name of God, the Most Great, the Most Glorious!

Glorified art Thou, O my God! Praise be unto Thee for having given Baha the cup of tribulation to drink. By Thy glory, O Thou Who art the Lord of all names! Through his love for Thee, Baha is not dismayed by tribulation, and through it he glories over all who are in earth and heaven. I beseech Thee not to disappoint those who have set their hopes on the court of Thy mercy. Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Powerful, the Gracious.

## BH11090: Glorified art Thou, O my God! This… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty, the Alone, the Most Bountiful, the Self-Subsisting.

Glorified art Thou, O my God! This is a handmaid from among Thy handmaids who, in the days of her youth, hath come to know Thee, and by night and by day hath lived in Thy companionship. O my God, ordain for her every good and every well-being which Thou dost send down, for, verily, Thou art powerful over all things.

## BH11091: Glorified art Thou, O my God and my Beloved!… {.unnumbered}

Glorified art Thou, O my God and my Beloved! Thou seest my poverty and neediness amidst both the loved ones and the wayward. Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for Thy decree and ordainment, and thanks be unto Thee, O my Lord, for Thy direction and execution thereof. And we bear witness that Thou art the All-Bountiful in Thy deeds and the Sovereign in Thy dominion, and Thou art powerful over all things.

## BH11093: We have been afflicted with consuming grief, a troubled… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted is He!

We have been afflicted with consuming grief, a troubled life, and clinging tribulation. We praise God in all these things. Our gaze has ever been fixed upon the Most Exalted Horizon and our face turned toward the Most Glorious Countenance. And we say: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having singled us out for tribulations in Thy path. Verily Thou art the Lord of the last and the first.

## BH11106: In My Name, the Most Holy, the Most Ancient… {.unnumbered}

In My Name, the Most Holy, the Most Ancient, the Most Great!

Say: O my God! Thou seest me standing before the throne of Thy grandeur, hearing Thy call, gazing upon Thy countenance, holding fast to the cord of Thy bounty, and clinging to the hem of Thy grace. I beseech Thee to assist me in serving Thy Cause, then to unite my scattered affairs that I may become capable of teaching Thy Cause. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH11260: Glorified is He Who sends down verses at all… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

Glorified is He Who sends down verses at all times, and through them the Sun has shone forth from a holy and exalted horizon. O handmaiden of God! Give thanks unto thy Lord that thou mayest be accounted among those who are well-pleasing in the Book. Then be thou devoutly obedient and prostrate thyself before a luminous and glorious Countenance.

## BH11255: Fear ye God and commit not oppression and wickedness… {.unnumbered}

Fear ye God and commit not oppression and wickedness within yourselves, which are to turn away from My Beauty and to oppose My Cause after the horizons have been illumined by the lights of this holy, pure, mighty and gleaming Daybreak....

## BH11290: Say: Today, no one will be benefitted by anything… {.unnumbered}

Say: Today, no one will be benefitted by anything but clinging to the praiseworthy shining Handle. And if they say, He forged it,' reply, then produce forgeries the like of what hath been revealed!'—so that they may witness their own impotence and may be among those who comprehend. Say: By God, were you to gather together with all those on the earth so as to produce a similar verse, they would be unable to accomplish it....

## BH11223: O Most Exalted Pen! If thou desirest to ordain… {.unnumbered}

O Most Exalted Pen! If thou desirest to ordain martyrdom for a servant who is present before the Throne, ordain as he hath wished in the path of God, the King, the Glorious, the Most High, the Great. Say: We have testified to his martyrdom in His love. Verily, He is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

## BH11224: O Muhammad! Grieve not over all that We have… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty

O Muhammad! Grieve not over all that We have attributed to thee, for whatsoever appeareth from the Beloved is beloved. Then stand firm in thy love and put thy trust in God, thy Lord. Verily He will fulfill His promise, and God doth not fail in His promise.

## BH11261: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Praise be unto… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Great, the Most Glorious!

Glorified art Thou, O my God! Praise be unto Thee for having expended me for the quickening of all who are in Thy heaven and on Thy earth, and for having made me a target for the darts of destiny for the exaltation of Thy Word. Do Thou guide, O my God, Thy servants unto the straight path. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Bestower.

## BH11262: Glorified art Thou, O my God, O Creator… {.unnumbered}

He is God, the Most Mighty, the Most Glorious

Glorified art Thou, O my God, O Creator of the heavens and Ruler of all names! I beseech Thee by Thy Beauty which hath shone forth from the horizon of glory, to gather together Thy loved ones beneath the canopies of Thy grace and then to make them drink of that which will quicken their hearts in Thy days. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful, the Supreme, the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting.

## BH11276: He is the Mighty, the Beloved! Glory be unto… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the Beloved! Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Him through Whom Thou didst raise up the standards of Thy guidance and establish the banners of Thy singleness, to aid whosoever seeketh Thine aid and to protect whosoever seeketh Thy protection. Verily, Thou art powerful to do this.

## BH11277: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee… {.unnumbered}

Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst manifest Thy beauty, perfect Thy Cause, strengthen Thy proof, and make known and declare Thy attributes, that Thou mayest cause Thy servants to ascend unto the station wherein Thy friend gazeth from the throne of Thy glory and the seat of Thy majesty. Verily, Thou art powerful over all things and all-wise.

## BH11302: The letter reached me today, Thursday. Through the grace… {.unnumbered}

He is the Great Witness.

The letter reached me today, Thursday. Through the grace of God, your affairs have been, and will continue to be, gathered together and firmly established; for, inasmuch as ye are with us and of us, to turn to His succor need occasion no fear. God willing, after the meeting you will depart. Whenever it becomes possible, set forth and present yourselves. God’s blessings be upon you.

## BH11307: This is a Book from the presence of Bahá… {.unnumbered}

This is a Book from the presence of Bahá unto him who hath been named Muhammad in the Book of Names, that he may soar on the wings of longing through this pure, sanctified, mighty and wondrous air.

We beseech God to ordain for thee every good in His manifest Book.

Glory be upon the loved ones of God, the Lord of all the worlds.

## BH11357: Know ye O ye inhabitants of the earth! My… {.unnumbered}

He is the Manifest!

Know ye O ye inhabitants of the earth! My Hair is My sword. It kills the lovers when in separation and then clothes itself in the black garment in their mourning. This is one of its most wonderful attributes from the beginning which has had no beginning. O ye who are strangers, fly away from it, O ye people of disputation.

## BH11403: In the days when the chiefs of the Bayan… {.unnumbered}

In the days when the chiefs of the Bayan would pay dearly for women's veils to conceal and protect themselves from enemies, the Ancient Beauty arose to aid the Cause, although all peoples had risen to oppose Him....

## BH11383: Lawh-i-Zaynu'l-Muqarrabin(?) {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH11391: O my handmaiden! You have become aware… {.unnumbered}

He is I

O my handmaiden! You have become aware of the characteristics of the Beauty of Oneness and have learned of the sanctification of the Ancient Being. Inform the handmaidens of God so that they may purify themselves from that which God does not love.

## BH11397: He is the Bestower, the Forgiver. Some must depart… {.unnumbered}

He is the Bestower, the Forgiver. Some must depart from the blessed city for a specified time period while others must depart forever, unless they repent unto God, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

## BH11405: Glorified art Thou, O Lord of existence and Sovereign… {.unnumbered}

He is the Luminous, the All-Glorious, the Most Glorious

Glorified art Thou, O Lord of existence and Sovereign of kings and Merciful One to the servants! This servant hath turned toward Thy gate and desired Thy bounties, and being hungry hath sought Thy favors, and being thirsty hath sought the stream of Thy mercy.

## BH11435: When I contemplate, O my God, the relationship… {.unnumbered}

He is

When I contemplate, O my God, the relationship that bindeth me to Thee, I am moved to proclaim to all created things "verily I am God!"; and when I consider my own self, lo, I find it coarser than clay!

## BH11512: We have revealed, for her who hath ascended unto… {.unnumbered}

We have revealed, for her who hath ascended unto the Supreme Companion, a wondrous abode of nearness. By God! We behold her among the celestial maidens.

## BH11493: In the name of God, the Most Unapproachable… {.unnumbered}

In the name of God, the Most Unapproachable, the Most Holy, the Most Exalted, the Most Glorious. O Lord! Bestow upon me mercy from Thy presence, for verily Thou art the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

## BH11521: This is a luminous page which We have caused… {.unnumbered}

This is a luminous page which We have caused to bear the pearls of wisdom and utterance. Whoso looketh upon it, that one is indeed of the people of Bahá.
